caption:
Another price cut does not mean the original reference stays forever.

Example: a product has a full history at ₹1,000, then falls to ₹900. A later reduction to ₹800 may have ₹900 as the lowest recorded price in its preceding window.

Check the relevant history again. Do not keep using the highest earlier price simply because the discount looks bigger.

India Prior Price uses the prices it recorded for the relevant window. Example only. Coming soon. Follow for launch.

Not legal advice.
